question: Should this PR carry the broad durable queue-owned media handoff as the supported fix for Codex generated-image duplicate/drop behavior, or should the typed result-byte transfer be narrowed before merge?
rationale: Persisting typed Codex result bytes matches the upstream contract, but this branch also changes message-delivery media ownership and is dirty against main, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent merge shape or proof bar.

options.title: Rebase and prove broad handoff
options.body: Resolve conflicts while preserving current-main inventory and delivery semantics, then require focused outbound/gateway media tests plus live generated-image delivery proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow to Codex transfer
options.body: Split durable queue-media receipt work away if maintainers want the result-byte bug fixed with less message-delivery surface area.

options.title: Pause for replacement branch
options.body: If conflict resolution becomes branch reconstruction, keep this PR as source context and ask for a clean maintainer-pushable replacement branch.

recommendation.title: Rebase and prove broad handoff
recommendation.body: Resolve conflicts while preserving current-main inventory and delivery semantics, then require focused outbound/gateway media tests plus live generated-image delivery proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest combined history on Codex app-server projection and outbound delivery ownership decisions touched by this PR.
